notes:
## New features
- **Start card on an empty project.** A new project opens with a short card on the canvas: import the site from map data, open a project, or pick a drawing tool. The grid stays drawable around it, and the card goes once the model has anything in it.
- **Workspace names in the top bar.** The Editor, Inputs, 3D View, Results and Contours switch shows each workspace's name beside its icon.

## Changes
- **Colours meet WCAG AA contrast in light and dark.** The interactive teal is a deeper tone, so white text on teal buttons reads at 5:1 (it was 2.4:1). Teal text, muted text, warnings, errors, the Saved/Unsaved chip, the dark-mode Save button and the focus ring all reach the AA minimums. The AURIS logo and contour colours are unchanged, and dark mode uses the white logo.
- The inspector shows each value once. Buildings, barriers and berms have one Height field (two showed the same value at different precisions); the ID is no longer repeated in the header and body; labels have no trailing colons, as in every other panel.
- The inspector header shows the same icon as the object's drawing tool instead of a two-letter code.
- Checkboxes in lists, trees and tables (3D objects, time-slice sources) show an empty box when off.
- Unavailable inspector buttons look unavailable.
- Vertex tables no longer cut off their "Base (m)" and "Height (m)" headers.
- The receptor stack list marks the selected receptor.
- Inputs lists sources and roads first, then receptors, then barriers and buildings. A receptor without a level says "not calculated".
- Results no longer repeats the scenario name on every row (exports keep it). A numeric last column (Margin) stays beside its header.
- The live preview menu says what it sets ("Preview: Balanced") and drops Auto, which sampled exactly as Balanced.
- Compliance Profile lists its locked assumptions in plain terms, as Settings names them.
- The Acoustic Probe names source types in words and shows the sum of its contributions.
- Unhide All Buildings moves to ⇧⌘H: ⌘H is macOS's Hide AURIS.

## Bug fixes
- A barrier height typed into the barrier panel and then saved or calculated without pressing Return was lost.
- Opening a project after visiting Results showed "not run yet" although the project had saved runs.
- One road with a measured LA10 input made every road's inspector show "Road preparation requires review" with no fields. Each road now opens the editor for its own method.
- The Acoustic Probe calculated each source's contribution on the ISO route even for CRTN roads and CRN railways, so the rows did not add up to the exact level (60.6 dB against 63.96 dB on one model). Contributions now use the same method as the total and add up to it.
- A line source's "LpA at 10 m" is a level in dB, not dB/m.
- Inspector panels that cannot grow (the road traffic editor) sat in the middle of spare height, leaving a gap under the header.
